raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Starting with batch 12, the source stopped sending status 'POSTED' and now sends 'SETTLED' instead, while 'REVERSED' still appears. The counts support a straight rename: SETTLED (986) fits entirely within batches 12-14, the implied reversal rate there (~4.5%) matches batches 1-11 (~4.9%), and txn_ids are unique, so nothing is double-counted.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status IN ('POSTED', 'SETTLED');"}}
